newsitem.title: ITALY: FORECAST - Italy market sees only small o/n rate fall.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Italy market sees only small o/n rate fall.

text.p: Italy's money market continues to expect a modest fall in the overnight rate on a one-month horizon, a study by the Bocconi University research arm Igier showed.
The study, based on implicit overnight rates, showed the market saw o/n at 7.34 percent in one month, up from 7.25 percent seen a week ago.
The actual market close was at 7.44 percent on Thursday, the day Igier based its study.
In three months, the implicit o/n rate is seen at 7.18 percent compared with expectations of 7.04 percent last week and 6.94 percent last month.
Over the longer term expectations were more uncertain. On a one-year horizon, the implicit o/n rate is seen at 6.88 percent, higher than the 6.64 percent seen a week ago and 6.22 percent last month.
In two years, the implicit o/n rate is expected at 7.04 percent, up from 6.81 percent last week and 6.38 percent last month.

The spread between the implicit Italian o/n rate and the implicit German o/n rate on a two-year horizon is seen as a good indicator of market confidence in Italy's entry into European economic and monetary union.
The spread widened to 245 basis points from last week's 235 bps and 189 bps a month ago.
